sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:49

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:49:1
items.html: The first ones did not die: Rather, the Kamatz returned to the Nikvey Einayim as it had been before, and likewise the Patach again remained alone in the vessel of Hochma. For since they are in their place, just as they were at the beginning of their emanation, (56) they are regarded as the anterior vessels, in which no annulment or breaking operates.
